verdict_reason: Imagery stack (NICFI Asia, Sentinel-1 GRD, Sentinel-2 SR) is open via GEE and confirmed to cover Malaysia. No open MPOB TSPKS or smallholder plot-boundary dataset exists; a validated ground truth needs a partner (MPOB extension officer or MSPO cooperative) for hand-collected plots, with no confirmed access process.

sources.name: NICFI Planet Basemaps (Asia mosaic) via GEE
sources.licence_quote: high-resolution satellite monitoring of the tropics for the primary purpose of reducing and reversing the loss of tropical forests
caveats_quoted: This data has usage, reproduction, and distribution restrictions in support of the NICFI Satellite Data Program purpose.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 GRD (SAR)
sources.licence_quote: The use of Sentinel data is governed by the Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions.
sources.coverage_quote: Global coverage (-90 to 90 latitude, -180 to 180 longitude)

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized
sources.licence_quote: The use of Sentinel data is governed by the Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions.
sources.coverage_quote: 2017-2018 L2 coverage is not yet complete globally.
caveats_quoted: 2017-2018 L2 coverage is not yet complete globally.

sources.name: Descals et al. global industrial and smallholder oil palm map (2019)
sources.licence_quote: This work is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License
sources.coverage_quote: Southeast Asia ranks as the main producing region with an oil palm area estimate of 18.69 Mha
caveats_quoted: The classified images (oil_palm_map folder, GeoTIFF) are the output of a CNN on Sentinel-1/2 half-yearly composites.

sources.name: MPOB - TSPKS smallholder holding records
sources.coverage_quote: No public TSPKS plot-boundary dataset found; Dataset link routes to data.gov.my, which has no oil-palm smallholder layer.
caveats_quoted: Smallholder Extension & Certification Division contact: general@mpob.gov.my, 603-87694400; no application form or deadline published.

sources.name: MSPO Traceability Search Engine
caveats_quoted: The Traceability Search Engine enables palm oil to be tracked from plantation to mill and beyond.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: No public MPOB TSPKS or smallholder plot-boundary dataset exists. Protocol: recruit smallholders via MPOB extension officer/MSPO cooperative, record GPS pin, hand-digitize plot outline on NICFI/S2 imagery; target 30-50 plots for validation.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (NICFI Asia + COPERNICUS/S1_GRD + COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED, server-side compositing and SAR analysis)
compute_path.why: All raster processing (mosaicking, speckle filtering, change detection) runs server-side on GEE; no local GPU or multi-day training needed.
